outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 (branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: observation/graders.json is the only grader selection, and startup validates and registers it (observation/src/grading/configuration.ts, observation/src/main.ts). T2: cited files are read at the assessed commit, and a file missing there is recorded as absent (observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts, observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #790 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. It inspects the checked-out branch, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/main.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the analysis, spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

findings.description: The audit target is exact: the checkout HEAD and PR 790 head are 35d68538002b07532c95879a9ae3a98d5c01fa26 on cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b. The committed audit input records the operator-authorized existing-PR override at observation/verification/inputs/registration-audit.json:2-18, so no additional operator choice is required.

T1 is supported. observation/src/grading/configuration.ts:10-49 defines and strictly parses the sole graders.json configuration, and observation/src/grading/configuration.ts:72-149 validates configured graders and produces registration pins. observation/src/main.ts:17-33 selects graders.json and validates credentials, while observation/src/main.ts:65-85 reads, prepares, and registers definitions before serving.

T2 is supported. observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts:71-101 locates the repository holding assessment head_sha, reads each file at that commit, and emits is_absent true for a missing path. observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts:19-42 uses git cat-file against the exact commit and distinguishes absent paths from unavailable commits or repositories.

Focused tests cover both obligations: observation/tests/grader-configuration.test.ts:26-176 checks sole selection, registration, validation, and rejection cases; observation/tests/git-repository-reader.test.ts:42-73 checks exact-commit reads and absent-file evidence. The analyst did not run the observation suite, preserving the specification requirement that the builder run it exactly once.

The required assessment shape is supported by workflow-config/development.yaml:105-123 and workflow-config/prompts/development/assess.md:50-74: head_sha, per-task findings, file/test/output evidence, and test_evidence are all representable. The audit override must supersede the ordinary PR draft mutation at workflow-config/prompts/development/assess.md:43-48.
